name: Kizakura Kouichi
source: Kizakura Kouichi is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director. His responsibility as the director is general HR, including scouting of members and branch heads, distribution of personnel, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
